page.title: Team templates
filter.label: Filter
list.empty: No team templates yet. A team template bundles a coordinator, delegatable members, and a way of working—publish one, then choose it in a session.
list.onlyArchived: All team templates are archived. Switch to "Archived" to see them, or create a new one.
editor.loadFailed: Could not load this team template. Go back to the list and try again.
editor.archivedHint: Archived templates are read-only. Duplicate one for an editable copy, or unarchive to edit, publish, and use in sessions again.
editor.builtinHint: Built-in templates are read-only and can be used in sessions as-is. Choose "Duplicate" to create an editable copy.
editor.archiveConfirm.title: Archive this template?
editor.archiveConfirm.description: Archived templates are read-only and leave the default list. Drafts and published versions are kept.
editor.noChanges: The current content matches the published version.
editor.basic.title: Basics
editor.basic.description: Fill in a name and description in at least one language; they appear in the team list and in sessions.
editor.basic.languageHint: Both languages are optional; the interface falls back to the other one when one is missing.
editor.members.title: Coordinator and members
editor.members.description: The coordinator dispatches and summarizes; members are the agents it can delegate to.
editor.members.coordinatorHint: The coordinator must have delegation enabled; an issue appears below if it is not.
editor.members.noCoordinator: The current coordinator is not among published agents; choose another one.
editor.members.noAgents: No published agents yet. Create and publish one in Agents settings first.
editor.members.noMembers: No members available. Publish more agents or choose a different coordinator.
editor.pattern.title: Way of working
editor.pattern.description: Decide how members take part: free delegation, review rounds, or staged execution.
editor.pattern.label: Way of working
editor.pattern.hint.delegate: The coordinator decides which subtasks to hand out; best for clear, parallelizable work.
editor.pattern.hint.review-loop: A maker produces and a checker reviews, round after round until it passes or the limit is reached.
editor.pattern.hint.pipeline: Stages run in dependency order; best for fixed steps with clear hand-offs.
editor.pattern.reviewHint: Both maker and checker must be the coordinator or a member; the loop ends at the round limit.
editor.pattern.pipelineEmpty: No stages yet. Add one, or fill them in from the members.
editor.pattern.pipelineHint: A stage can only depend on earlier stages; execution follows the dependency order.
editor.pattern.ignoredHint: With free delegation, pipeline and review-loop settings are kept but ignored.
editor.footer: A team template only affects how sessions collaborate; the member agents themselves are not modified.
versions.title: Version history
versions.description: Every publish leaves a version behind. Compare the current draft with a version, or restore an old version as the draft. Publishing a restore creates a new version and never rewrites history.
versions.empty: Nothing published yet. Once published, versions can be compared and restored here.
versions.noDiff: This version matches the current draft.
versions.restoreDescription: The current draft will be replaced by this version. You can keep editing; publishing creates a new version without rewriting history.
versions.loadFailed: Failed to load the version. Try again later.
editor.leave.title: Save changes?
editor.leave.description: Save your changes to this team template before leaving.
editor.publishConfirm.title: Publish v{{version}}?
editor.publishConfirm.description: This template has {{count}} agents including the coordinator; the member agents themselves are not modified.
issue.team.name_required: Enter a name in at least one language
issue.team.description_required: Enter a description in at least one language
issue.team.coordinator_cannot_delegate: The coordinator has no delegation enabled; turn it on in Agents settings first
issue.team.member_is_coordinator: The coordinator cannot also be a member
issue.team.review_loop_required: A review loop needs a maker and a checker
issue.team.review_agent_missing: {{agent}} is not the coordinator or a member
issue.team.review_same_agent: The maker and checker must be different agents
issue.team.pipeline_required: A pipeline needs at least one stage
issue.team.pattern_ignores_pipeline: Free delegation does not use pipeline settings
issue.team.pattern_ignores_review_loop: Free delegation does not use review-loop settings
issue.team.member_not_allowed: Member {{agent}} is outside the coordinator's allowed delegation targets
